d.ko: A Lovecraftian idle RPG with auto-battles, loot farming, chests, team strategy, town building, gear crafting, Runewords, stages, towers, realms, and seasons. Serve the Old Gods, build your town, corrupt the chosen, and fight for their awakening!
d.en: A Lovecraftian idle RPG with auto-battles, loot farming, chests, team strategy, town building, gear crafting, Runewords, stages, towers, realms, and seasons. Serve the Old Gods, build your town, corrupt the chosen, and fight for their awakening!
d.zh: 这是一款克苏鲁题材，集自动战斗、刷宝、开箱子、策略搭配、城镇建设、装备打造、符文之语、推关、爬塔、异界、赛季玩法于一体的放置挂机游戏。你将成为古神最忠实的仆从，建设城镇，蛊惑神选者，为古神复苏而战！
